author: Intel
description:
Negative testing is a quality assurance technique used to evaluate how a system behaves when subjected to invalid, unexpected, or malicious inputs. Unlike positive testing, which confirms that a system works as intended under normal conditions, the goal of negative testing is to ensure that the system fails gracefully and remains secure when things go wrong. Join host Jerry Bryant as he dives into this topic with Intel Vice President Vivek Tiwari. For more information, read the 2026 Intel Platform Security Report at www.intel.com/securityreport.
